info.title: ugiAPI
info.description:
REST API for Valorant player data. All endpoints are GET and return `{"status":200,"data":{...}}`; errors return `{"status","error","code","request_id","details?"}` - branch on `code`.

Rate limits: per-minute and daily request quota plus a Riot query budget (only uncached lookups count). See https://api.ugilabs.com/docs/ and https://api.ugilabs.com/llms.txt.

get.description: PUUID, name, tag, account level, player card and title.
Same as getAccount, looked up by PUUID.
Current competitive tier and RR, all-time peak tier and a per-act summary (by_season).
Same as getRank, looked up by PUUID.
Same as getRankHistory, looked up by PUUID.
Recent matches with the player's stats. mode is applied by Riot before size; start pages through Riot's history (each new page costs one Riot query).
Same as getMatches, looked up by PUUID (name and tag are null).

Matches kept in the ugiAPI match store (newest first) with a summary over all matching records. Reads only from the database: no Riot query cost except resolving the Riot ID. The store fills up as matches are fetched through ugiAPI; it can have gaps and summary.matches is not a lifetime count.
Same as getStoredMatches, by PUUID (no Riot query at all).
Full match: info, all players with stats and combat, teams and rounds. Region is auto-detected when omitted.
Leaderboard page for an act (current act by default).
Agents, maps, acts, game modes, player cards and titles.
Riot service status for a region. No API key needed.

apiKeyQuery.name: api_key
apiKeyQuery.description: Works, but ends up in logs.

force.name: force
force.description: Premium only: skip the cache (once per 10 s per player and endpoint). Other plans: 400 force_not_allowed.

start.name: start
start.description: Index in Riot's match history (0 = latest). Use pagination.next_start.

map.name: map
map.description: Map name, e.g. Ascent. Unknown: 400 invalid_map.

agent.name: agent
agent.description: Agent name or UUID. Unknown: 400 invalid_agent.

XUpstreamCost.description: Riot queries spent by this request

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (bad_request, missing_parameters, invalid_region, invalid_name, invalid_tag, invalid_puuid, invalid_match_id, invalid_act, invalid_locale, invalid_mode, invalid_map, invalid_agent, invalid_parameter, force_not_allowed)

peak.description: Highest tier across all acts (no RR).

Combat.description: Derived from round data; null for matches cached before v1.2.0.
